'''Ezrim''', also called '''Old Ezrim''', was a moisture farmer on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] once caught in [[Tosche Station/Legends|Tosche Station]] during a sandstorm. Convinced that a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operatives were actually [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], he confronted them and eventually brought about a firefight between the Rebels and a group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].
